description: This file defines a mock class 'ControlServerInternalFactoryMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IControlServerInternalFactory' interface. It uses Google Mock to mock methods for creating control and control server internal objects within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace.

classes.name: ControlServerInternalFactoryMock
